policies.sentence: Students must cite or disclose AI use in comments within their code.
Students must mark exactly which lines, functions or classes AI generated.
Students must record the AI tool used, with version, and the prompt in the code.
Students must cite AI code even after editing it, and say whether it is verbatim or modified.
Students must cite AI code only when it is nontrivial.
Students must cite code from online or other outside sources, including AI, in comments.
Students must list AI-written lines in the README.
The AI citation needs to appear only once, in the file's header comment.
Students must not copy code from AI without citing it.
